summary_1line: Matanga performs extreme penance to gain Brahmana status, but Indra repeatedly insists that such status cannot be attained by one born a Chandala.

image_candidates.scene_text: Matanga stands motionless on one foot in the forest for centuries, emaciated and radiant with ascetic fire as Indra appears before him in the sky.
The god Indra confronts the austere Matanga amid the wilderness, warning him that the status of a Brahmana is unattainable despite his severe penance.
A gaunt Matanga, after a thousand years of standing on one foot in meditation, asks Indra why he has still not gained the status of a Brahmana.
